title: Stock futures are little changed ahead of pivotal Fed rate decision: Live updates
summary: Stock futures show minimal movement as traders anticipate a potential new rate hiking cycle from the Federal Reserve, a key factor influencing near-term market direction.
content: Traders brace for the possibility of a new rate hiking cycle from the Federal Reserve.

zh.title: 股票期货在美联储关键利率决议前涨跌不大：实时更新
zh.summary: 股票期货显示最少的波动，因为交易员预期美联储可能启动新的加息周期，这是影响近期市场方向的关键因素。

title: BOJ expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to fresh three-decade high: CNBC survey
summary: The Bank of Japan is expected to raise rates by 25 basis points to its highest level in three decades, signaling continued efforts to normalize monetary policy.
content: The BOJ is expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to a fresh three-decade high, a CNBC survey shows.

zh.title: 日本央行预期加息25个基点至三十年高位：CNBC调查
zh.summary: 日本央行预期加息25个基点至三十年来的最高水平，表明继续努力实现货币政策正常化。

title: Indonesia's new finance minister faces an uphill battle on fiscal credibility
summary: Indonesia's newly appointed finance minister Nazara, a former deputy minister with extensive fiscal policy experience, faces significant challenges in restoring fiscal credibility after his predecessor's dismissal.
content: Nazara, sworn in hours after Purbaya's dismissal, spent seven years as deputy finance minister and led the ministry's fiscal policy agency from 2015 to 2019.

zh.title: 印度尼西亚新财政部长在财政信誉方面面临艰巨挑战
zh.summary: 印度尼西亚新任财政部长纳扎拉是前副部长，拥有丰富的财政政策经验，在前任被解职后面临恢复财政信誉的重大挑战。

title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but 'should trust' AI firms
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledges legitimate fears about AI's impact but urges trust in technology firms; executives claim economic incentives naturally limit AI advancement risks.
content: Sam Altman and other tech CEOs say there are incentives to limit advancements in AI, as fears grow over the threats it poses to humanity.

zh.title: OpenAI首席执行官表示世界"有理由感到害怕"但"应该信任"AI公司
zh.summary: OpenAI首席执行官Sam Altman承认人们对AI影响的合理担忧，但敦促相信科技公司；高管声称经济激励自然限制了AI进步的风险。

title: House to vote on bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
summary: Bipartisan legislation would establish a regulatory framework enabling states to prevent data center operators from passing utility costs onto consumers.
content: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.

zh.title: 众议院将投票表决限制AI数据中心公用事业成本的法案
zh.summary: 两党立法将建立监管框架，使各州能够阻止数据中心运营商将公用事业成本转嫁给消费者。
